method: Manual review of ITU SpaceExplorer public dashboards, official SNL publication indexes and published RES35 reports. No dates inferred backwards from BIU. Unknown fields remain null.

chn-sailspace-1.noteZh: 此行对应 125500033 通知摘要。MIFR 为网络关联通知的汇总状态；存在 PART II-S 及其他指配的 PART III-S，不能视为全部频段无条件获准。
chn-sailspace-1.noteEn: This row covers notification 125500033. MIFR is a related-notice aggregate; PART II-S and PART III-S for other assignments do not imply unconditional approval of all bands.

chn-gw-a59.noteZh: 协调通知 120520170 的公开摘要；当前修改收件为 2024-07-17，不替代原频率组时钟。最早监管期限为网络汇总，2025 API 新频段不能直接套用。
chn-gw-a59.noteEn: Public summary of coordination notice 120520170; modification received 2024-07-17 is not the original frequency-group clock. Earliest limit is network-wide; do not apply it blindly to 2025 API additions.

chn-gw-2.noteZh: 公开协调版本摘要为 1,728 颗，不代表国网整体 12,992 颗目标。通知 125500219 正在审查；网络未确认 BIU 不代表物理星座未发射。
chn-gw-2.noteEn: Public coordination-version summary is 1,728, not Guowang’s overall 12,992 target. Notification 125500219 is under examination; unconfirmed BIU does not mean the physical fleet has not launched.

usa-usasat-ngso-8a.noteZh: RES35 状态表为 1,154 颗；当前协调版本公开摘要为 1,154–1,156 颗，保留两种口径，不擅自合并。通知 126500007 正在审查。轨道与频率为摘要范围，不表示区间连续占用。
usa-usasat-ngso-8a.noteEn: RES35 status table: 1,154; current coordination summary: 1,154–1,156. Both scopes retained, not merged. Notification 126500007 is under examination. Orbit/frequency envelopes do not imply continuous occupancy.

usa-usasat-ngso-8b.noteZh: RES35 状态表为 1,294 颗；协调版本摘要为 1,294–1,296 颗。通知 126500008 正在审查。频率为范围摘要，不表示区间连续占用。
usa-usasat-ngso-8b.noteEn: RES35 status table: 1,294; coordination summary: 1,294–1,296. Notification 126500008 under examination. Frequency envelopes are not continuously occupied intervals.

g-l5ka.noteZh: 2,692 是状态表网络通知数量；报告部分频段的通知分母为 720，不能把整个网络总量直接当作所有 Ka 频段的履约分母。父网络最早申报日不替代各频率组计时。
g-l5ka.noteEn: 2,692 is the status-table network count; some reported bands have a 720 notified denominator. Do not apply the network total to all Ka-band compliance ratios. Parent receipt does not replace frequency-group clocks.

usa-usasat-ngso-8c.noteZh: RES35 状态表为 782 颗；协调版本摘要为 782–784 颗。通知 126500009 正在审查。频率为范围摘要，不表示区间连续占用。
usa-usasat-ngso-8c.noteEn: RES35 status table: 782; coordination summary: 782–784. Notification 126500009 under examination. Frequency envelopes are not continuously occupied intervals.

ctc-1.noteZh: ITU 公开摘要确认 96,714 颗；关联 API 与协调通知不相加。组织字段空白，不能归入国网或千帆。轨道跨度含非低轨部分。
ctc-1.noteEn: ITU public summary confirms 96,714; linked API/coordination notices are not additive. Organization field is blank; not assigned to Guowang/Qianfan. Orbital range includes non-LEO regimes.

ctc-2.noteZh: ITU 公开摘要确认 96,714 颗；不是获批建设总量。组织字段空白，不能归入国网或千帆；关联空间站数不代表已部署卫星数。
ctc-2.noteEn: ITU public summary confirms 96,714, not an authorized build-out. Organization field is blank; not assigned to Guowang/Qianfan. Associated space-station records are not deployed-satellite counts.

additionalFilings.frequencySummary: Tx 2200–7750 MHz (2 bands); Rx 2025–8400 MHz (2 bands)
additionalFilings.noteZh: 2025 API 版本与 2023 协调/2025 通知频段不同，数量不叠加。2030-04-07 是网络关联通知最早期限，未确认为此 API 的独立启用期限。商业归属仍为候选映射。
additionalFilings.noteEn: 2025 API bands differ from the earlier coordination/notification: counts are not additive. The network-wide 2030-04-07 limit is not verified for this API. Commercial mapping remains provisional.

largeApplications.statusEn: FCC application listed in a public notice, not a grant; not a late-2025 ITU filing.
